title: Navigating to /compliance-vault renders as Evidence Management, not a dedicated vault hub
description: There is no src/app/(private)/compliance-vault/page.jsx in vibrantix-client-panel — Glob of the full (private) app router tree confirms no compliance-vault directory exists. routeHeaderMapping.js's '/compliance-vault' entry sets title 'Evidence Management', implying the intended behavior is for this path to display the Evidence Management hub content. This case documents current real behavior end-to-end.
preconditions: Logged in as any authenticated user
steps: Observe the page that actually renders (Evidence Management page, a Next.js not-found fallback, or a redirect)
expectedResult: Document the exact observed behavior (likely a 404/not-found since no page.jsx exists for this exact path, unless a higher-level catch-all or redirect middleware intercepts it first). This must be reconciled against the routeHeaderMapping.js entry, which implies '/compliance-vault' was expected to resolve successfully.

title: 'View Details' on the Google Drive integration card navigates to a compliance-vault path with no matching page
description: GoogleDriveIntegrationCard.js:136-138 (rendered on the Integrations hub) calls router.push('/compliance-vault/integrations/google-drive') from its 'View Details' button. The working Google Drive detail page actually lives at /evidence-management/gdrive/page.jsx — a different path entirely. This end-to-end case confirms the real, currently-broken user journey.
preconditions: Google Drive integration is configured/enabled for the org (status.enabled or status.configured is true, so the 'View Details' button renders instead of the 'Integrate to view details' placeholder)
steps: Locate the Google Drive integration card
expectedResult: Browser navigates to /compliance-vault/integrations/google-drive, which has no corresponding page in the app router and renders a 404/not-found rather than the Google Drive detail view the user expects. Compare against the working destination /evidence-management/gdrive.

title: 'View Details' on the Jira integration card (with Prowler context) navigates to a compliance-vault path with no matching page
description: JiraIntegrationCard.js:115-130 builds a URL '/compliance-vault/integrations/jira' (optionally appending requirementId/frameworkId/checkName/auditId query params when invoked with prowlerContext, e.g. from a cloud-posture finding's linked Jira ticket) and pushes to it. No compliance-vault route exists to receive these params.
preconditions: Jira integration is configured for the org
Card is rendered with a prowlerContext (e.g. from a cloud-posture finding) supplying requirementId/frameworkId/checkName
steps: From a cloud-posture finding that has a linked Jira ticket, open the Jira integration card in that context
Observe the resulting URL and page
expectedResult: Browser navigates to '/compliance-vault/integrations/jira?requirementId=...&frameworkId=...&checkName=...&auditId=...' which 404s — the requirementId/frameworkId/checkName/auditId context carried in the query string is lost since no page consumes it.

title: 'View in Evidence' from an audit requirement's Integrations tab sends the auditor to a broken compliance-vault link instead of Evidence Management
description: EvidenceTab.jsx (audit-assurance requirement detail, integrations sub-tab) constructs router.push(`/compliance-vault?${params.toString()}`) at line 170 to deep-link an auditor from a specific requirement back to the evidence backing it. Since /compliance-vault has no page, this breaks a real cross-module audit workflow: the auditor loses their place and must manually re-navigate to /evidence-management.
preconditions: An audit requirement has linked evidence with integration-sourced data (auditId, requirementId present)
steps: Open an audit requirement's detail page under /audit-assurance/[auditId]
Go to the Integrations tab of the Evidence section
Trigger the action that calls handleViewInEvidence (navigates via the constructed compliance-vault URL)
expectedResult: Browser navigates to a /compliance-vault URL that 404s, breaking the auditor's cross-module traceability path from audit requirement to underlying evidence. Expected/desired behavior would be navigating to /evidence-management with the same query params preserved.

title: An evidence item usable as vault content moves through its full workflow state machine end-to-end
description: Since /compliance-vault has no distinct backend, any 'vault workflow' functionality is really the evidence.model.js status enum (draft → submitted → assigned → under_review → needs_revision/closed) driven by POST /:evidenceId/workflow/transition (evidence.routes.js:59), gated by 'evidence.update'. This case exercises the real state machine end-to-end as it would be surfaced in a vault detail/workflow screen.
preconditions: A newly-uploaded evidence item in status 'draft'
A reviewer user distinct from the uploader
steps: Submit the evidence item for review (transition draft → submitted)
As a reviewer, assign it to themselves (submitted → assigned)
Move it into under_review, then request a revision (under_review → needs_revision)
As the original uploader, address the revision and resubmit
expectedResult: Each transition succeeds only for a user holding 'evidence.update', the workflow history endpoint (GET /:evidenceId/workflow/history) records every transition with actor and timestamp, and the final status is 'closed'.

title: A 'certificate'-type evidence item with an approaching expirationDate produces no renewal alert (unlike Trust Vault's certifications)
description: trust-vault-service has a dedicated ExpiryAlertService.ts, expiryCheck.ts scheduled job, and a certification_expiry_alert.hbs email template driving real renewal alerts for certifications stored there. Evidence-management's 'certificate'-type documents (evidence.model.js metadata.expirationDate) have no equivalent job. Since compliance-vault's real backing store is evidence-management, this documents a genuine feature gap between what the module is expected to cover ('certification storage... expiry date tracking, renewal alerts') and what actually exists.
preconditions: An evidence item of type='certificate' with metadata.expirationDate set to 5 days from now
steps: Upload the certificate-type evidence item with the near-future expirationDate
Wait for (or manually trigger) any daily/scheduled job in vibrantix-backend that scans evidence for upcoming expirations
Check the notification center / email inbox for a renewal alert
expectedResult: No renewal alert is generated — confirms evidence-management has no equivalent to trust-vault-service's ExpiryAlertService for its own 'certificate' type documents. Users relying on compliance-vault (i.e. evidence-management) for certification expiry tracking will silently miss renewals; real certification lifecycle management with alerts exists only in Trust Vault (/trust-vault), a separate module/service.
